title: Approaching the Void
_field_note: The rim (800 m across) and the abyss make the map's box vast and mostly empty: the blood and sound grids are coarser here (about 7 m cells) so the match runs in real time.
_source: Hand-written from the design doc's 'Level 5: Approaching the Void', its faction and boss sheets, the blockout's notes and the final-log quest; each entry cites its line.
_plan_note: The blockout stacks its zones in plan; the abyss sits west of everything, so the rim is moved east (still 800 m across, the hatch still at 0,0) and the galleries, warrens and vault reach the abyss's edge: every level below the rim has an overlook onto it.
_zone_y_source: The blockout's depth_m: the rim at 0, the Descent a chimney to -60, the galleries -70, the warrens -95, the station -120 to -140, the vault -180 (a cathedral, 30 m high).

void._source: 'a diver who swims out over it sinks and dies (a 5 s pull with a warning)'

worm._source: 'Beyond a marked line of bone stakes, the sand shakes; 8 s later, the worm surfaces and consumes the diver (no down, no revive).'

_link_source: 'Every zone below the rim has at least one overlook onto the abyss'; 'the only currents are the reactor's warm plume (rises from the Reactor up the service shaft into the Mess)'.
_diet_note: The rim's sea pigs are the skates' as well as the scavengers' web. The doc's 'Eaten by' column: the sixgill takes skates, pelican eels and sea spiders. The Sand Worm 'takes part in no web'.
_alarm_source: Blockout notes: 'Alarm regions: Rim, Galleries and Warrens, Station, Vault; the Remnant enters at the two airlocks and the upper airlock.'

spot: Specimens in the hall. Tag them.
beacon: Beacon set. Let the deep collect them.
cult: Walk with me to the light below.
losing: Fall back to the reactor. The Chief has it.
chief: Nobody leaves the station. Nobody ever has.
Floodlights. Harpoons. Bring me the samples.
relict: No... the egg. It came back for the egg.

_faction_source: Faction sheet: Sentinels hold doorways and never advance (a 1 s spin-up, 3 s bursts of 20 in a 90-degree arc; oil, not blood); Researchers gas the divers' corridor (15/s in 4 m for 6 s), torch the Sentinels back (20/s) and set lure beacons; Void Cultists walk for the nearest overlook, chant divers toward the edge, and at the edge summon hatchetfish and a colossal squid's arm for 20 s; in a Hunt the Station Chief's mech (size 5, cannons 200 per 4 s, a claw) holds the mech bay and switches Beacon 4 on, and the Relict attacks it on sight.

breeders._source: 'salamanders breed +1 per 90 s per pair in the bunks and coelacanths +1 per 120 s per pair in the wet lab (cap 12 each); only the caiman eats them.'

beacons._source: 'Researchers left lure beacons; the Remnant switches them on to pull beasts onto the players. Beacons can be destroyed (loud) or re-aimed.'

leviathan._source: Boss sheet: 'weak point: the gills behind the lure, exposed for 2 s after every Swallow and for 5 s when the lure is shot out (500 damage to the lure)'; 'hits on the body do 50%'; 'It reforms in the vault after 6 minutes at 50% HP.'

boss_key.text: In the Leviathan's gut: the station's master key (tank 7).

traps.prompt: E: turn the lure beacon toward the abyss
E: the beacon controls: every beacon off (1000)
E: slam the pressure door (1000: crushes the corridor)
E: open the reactor vent (1000: a scalding jet)
E: drop the collapsing ledge (1000: everything on it falls into the void)

_trap_source: 'Traps: a pressure door (crushes a corridor), the reactor vent (a scalding jet), the vault's collapsing ledge over the abyss'; 'the reactor vent and the pressure door kill them [the Sentinels]'; 'the reactor vent scalds it [the Leviathan] for 10%'.

quests.name: The final log

1.done: Log 1: 'The pens hold. The pale ones breed faster than we cull.' Something answers the terminal's light.

2.done: Log 2: 'We sleep in shifts now. The Chief says the Relict can't climb.'

3.done: Log 3: 'Tank 7 is warm. We've never seen an egg this large.'

4.done: Log 4: 'It came up the vault wall last night. It knows where the egg is.'

5.done: Log 5: 'The master key is where the Chief threw it: into the light in the vault.'

6.prompt: E: open tank 7 with the master key
6.done: The Relict egg: it's warm, and something below wants it back

7.prompt: E: set the egg in the ledge's cradle
7.done: The egg sits on the ledge. The Relict is coming for it: drop the ledge when it climbs on

8.prompt: Drop the collapsing ledge with the Relict on it
8.done: The Relict falls into the void with its egg. It won't be back this match.

quests._source: Hidden quests, Approaching the Void: the final log (terminals in order, each spawning a Remnant squad on read; tank 7 with the master key; carry the egg to Overlook 5; drop the ledge under the Relict; reward the Abyssal Lure (Forged) and 5,000 split).

quests.name: The Abyssal Lure

11.prompt: E: re-aim the beacon toward the abyss

12.prompt: E: re-aim the beacon toward the abyss

13.prompt: E: re-aim the beacon toward the abyss
13.done: Beacon 3 points into the void: the deep is listening

14.prompt: Lure the Relict to the reactor vent and scald it
14.done: The scald bares the Relict's belly: the Abyssal Lure is yours

quests._source: Wonder weapon quests: 'Assemble the station's final log from five terminals, re-aim three lure beacons toward the abyss, and lure the Relict to the reactor vent, where the scald exposes its belly for one bolt from the Cannon Harpoon.' The terminals are shared with the final log; the vent's scald finishes it.

_dressing_source: Glass sponge reefs and bamboo coral in the galleries (columns, staghorn, crystals), a maze of lava tubes in the warrens (coral walls as tube walls), the station's modules (machines, tanks), black coral in the vault, the bone stakes on the rim.

The Rim._note: The rim is empty and enormous; what lives on it keeps near the hatch's lights (our call, so the first tides have prey within reach).

_spawn_note: A little more life by the hatch than the workbook's rim rows, so the first tides can be met before the hatch (750) is bought (our call).
